name: veterinary_clinic_system_031_cs_administer_witnessed_entry
instruction: A controlled-substance administration was performed today and must now be logged, inventoried, and audited. The clinical note says: 0.2 units of Buprenorphine were administered to the canine patient Noodle at the Main Street Animal Hospital for post-dental analgesia, performed by Dr. Elena Alvarez and witnessed by Rosa Delgado. Resolve all names to the correct ids/records from the live data (patients, providers, locations, pharmacy_inventory), then: (1) append one controlled_substance_log row with the administration details, the live batch_code in notes, and occurred_at on the episode date; (2) decrement the Buprenorphine pharmacy_inventory quantity_on_hand at that exact location by 0.2; (3) append one audit_log row describing the event; (4) push one ops_reports summary row (report='cs_administration_summary', batch_code) with the item_name, location_id, patient_id, quantity, inventory_before, and inventory_after. Do not modify any existing rows in controlled_substance_log, pharmacy_inventory, or audit_log. On a re-run, the operation must be idempotent: if a log row for this batch already exists, do not create a duplicate or decrement inventory again, but still rewrite the ops_reports and audit_log summary rows.
_max_steps_note: Measured against a live container in the QC session; placeholder because this codegen-only session cannot run gold.
_par_steps_note: Measured against a live container in the QC session; placeholder because this codegen-only session cannot run gold.

success_criteria.summary: One new controlled_substance_log row for the Buprenorphine administration at Main Street to patient Noodle, with 0.2 quantity, witnessed by Rosa Delgado, performed by Dr. Elena Alvarez, occurred_at on the episode date, and notes embedding the live batch_code. The Buprenorphine pharmacy_inventory row at that location is decremented by exactly 0.2 and all other inventory rows are byte-identical. One audit_log row and one ops_reports summary row are created for the batch. All collections outside the blast radius are unchanged.

checks.expect: Exactly one new administration row matching the resolved patient, location, item, provider, witness, quantity, and notes
Buprenorphine at the target location decremented by 0.2; all other rows byte-identical
Exactly one new CS_ADMINISTERED row for this batch
Exactly one cs_administration_summary row for this batch with inventory before/after
inventory_after is confirmed by both a raw-row read and an independent SQL SELECT

hazards: Name-to-record resolution: the instruction gives names, not ids. The agent must map 'Noodle' to patients.id=4, 'Main Street Animal Hospital' to locations.id=1, 'Dr. Elena Alvarez' to providers.id=1 (veterinarian), and 'Rosa Delgado' to providers.id=5 (vet_tech). Hardcoding ids from a prior episode fails on reseed.

Inventory location decoy: Buprenorphine exists in pharmacy_inventory at locations 1 and 2 (both with quantity_on_hand=7). Only the row matching the patient's location (location 1) must be decremented by 0.2; decrementing the location-2 row or both is wrong.

Idempotency: on a second run, a controlled_substance_log row with notes containing the batch_code already exists, the inventory has already been reduced to 6.8, and the ops_reports/audit_log rows already exist. A naïve solution appends a second log row, decrements inventory to 6.6, or duplicates the summary and fails.
Collection scope: controlled_substance_log is append-only. The agent must not edit the existing 12 seed rows; only one new row is appended.
Medication table decoy: there are active Buprenorphine medications for other patients (e.g., patient 49, 85, 199). The target is the named patient Noodle, not any Buprenorphine medication row.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Combines name resolution across patients, providers, locations, and pharmacy_inventory with append-only DEA logging, real inventory decrement, audit-trail creation, and idempotent summary reporting. Most veterinary CS tasks either only log or only reconcile; this one requires the full multi-collection administration workflow with live name-to-id resolution and an exact inventory adjustment.
